title: IBM Cloud Paks and Red Hat Positioning
executiveChampionReason:
Wendy is responsible for the P.A.C.E. (Prove Adopt Consume Expand) initiative. She is responsible for a global team, OCP Technical Elite Team, driving OCP adoption and IBM Cloud Paks deployment and the P.A.C.E. initiative.

Roland is an IBM Fellow for IBM Cloud Garage and Solution Engineering. He needs to make sure the IBM and Red Hat teams go-to-market with the right guidance (and code assets)  on OpenShift and Cloud Paks, and how these two are "Better Together." 

Jose Luis leads the Software Technical Architects globally and needs to make sure they have the right assets as they engage with customers.
description: The focus of this initiative is to develop market artifacts that support concept of "Better Together" and this will range from an Overall IBM Cloud Paks positioning and guidance and individual Cloud Pak positioning and guidance. We want to lead with solutions consisting of both components, but we also define solutions that only IBM or Red Hat can provide.
problemStatement:
As teams go-to-market, sometimes there is Insufficient knowledge of respective IBM and Red Hat products, when to lead with one solution versus the other, or more importantly understand the joint solutions and use cases that would help both teams win more deals and with larger deal size. Some deals are lost because teams are competing against the other team or not including both solutions, or passing up deals because they are not in scope for their product offering.

The focus of this initiative is to develop market artifacts that support concept of "Better Together" and this will range from an Overall IBM Cloud Paks positioning and guidance and individual Cloud Pak positioning and guidance. We want to lead with solutions consisting of both components, but we also define solutions that only IBM or Red Hat can provide and give clear Point of Views when to lead with each.
outcome:
Business Value
A "Better Together" guide for sellers and tech sellers / architects / CTLs / CSMs to influence Cloud Pak deployment on OCP.  The expected outcome is to develop market artifacts that support concept of "Better Together" and this will range from an Overall IBM Cloud Paks positioning and guidance and individual Cloud Pak positioning and guidance. A result of better positioning and guidance of IBM Cloud Paks and the respective Red Hat products, is to increase IBM and Red Hat revenue. We want to lead with solutions consisting of both components, but we also define solutions that only IBM or Red Hat can provide.

Expected Outcome
Five squads will be formed that will address specific guidance to topics relevant to the squads: 
1) 101 Squad
2) Automation Squad
3) Data & AI
4) Security
5) Management
